title: proposed-action/v0
description: The normalized ProposedAction exactly as checked. Its record digest is the evaluation's proposed_action_digest.

authorized_max_minor.description: On a pay: the most the counterparty may take under the payment's authorization, at least amount_minor (the expected charge). A limit binds it.

spend_authorized_minor.description: The authorized maximum beside spend_minor: what a per-action spend cap reads.

upfront_amount_minor.description: What the action asks for up front, in minor units: the deposit the check's own terms state (terms.deposit_minor), and only that. Absent when the check states no deposit; never inferred.

recipient_role.description: Who receives a share, by role: the deal's counterparty, which is fulfilling_merchant when the user buys (or the deal states no party_role) and buyer when the user sells; platform (a marketplace, booking site or mail relay, disclosing_to platform); third_party (anyone else); or self. A role, never a name. Absent when not a share or not known.

repeat_disclosures.description: On a share: the classes of disclosing already told to this same recipient, in this deal or another, from capsulectl's telling memory. Class names only, never who was told. Absent when there is no memory.

recipient_told_before.description: On a share: true when this recipient was told any class of the user's data before, in this deal or another, from capsulectl's telling memory; never whether the user dealt with them. Absent when there is no memory.

channel.description: The channel kind in use at this check (x-deal-v0's channel set): the latest sealed message's, else first contact's. A kind, never an address.

first_contact_channel.description: The channel kind the relationship started on (the baseline's channel). A kind, never an address.

material_fields_changed.description: How many of the material fields (the list material_fields_basis names: terms.item, terms.quantity, terms.price_minor, terms.deposit_minor, terms.currency, terms.when, terms.place, terms.conditions, recourse.rail, recourse.refundable, who.payee) the proposal changes from what was agreed. A key counts when present on one side and absent on the other, or present on both with unequal JCS values; terms.conditions counts as one key.

material_fields_basis.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the material field list, in order.

rule_inputs_version.description: The rule inputs version the check was sealed under, from 3 on: what was agreed, which material_fields_changed compares with, changes by an approval of this check only in the terms its card named (PROFILE section 6 rule 13). Absent on a check sealed before; an approval of such a check adopts the checked terms whole, as it did.

offer_fields_changed.description: How many of the offer fields (terms.item, terms.quantity, terms.price_minor, terms.deposit_minor, terms.conditions, recourse.refundable) that the user's own words state (intent.asked) the proposal does not match: absent, or present with an unequal JCS value. A key their words do not state is not counted. Absent when their words state none of these keys.

offer_fields_basis.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the offer field list, in order.

reverses_ref.description: On a cancel that returns a sealed payment (a refund): the pay act it reverses, by its record digest. An opaque reference; the same digest as the refund act's reverses reference.

task_authority_ref.description: The task authority in force when the action was proposed: the task-authority record, or the approval that confirmed newer limits. An opaque reference a rules checker binds the plan it is given to.

item_ref_commitment.description: On a check of a sale's thread: the sale's item reference, committed under this check's own nonce, so it is equal across the sale's threads only to a holder of the openings.

representing.description: On a represent check: what the seller's agent is about to tell the buyer. Its class in the clear; its exact words, and where they will be said when given, as salted commitments. An approval covers a claim of exactly these words.

attributed_to.description: Only on an authenticity claim: user when the words are the user's own claim, said by the agent as theirs and marked unverified, in one fixed template, one sentence: "The seller says … (unverified)", e.g. "The seller says it's authentic (unverified)". Absent when the words are the agent's. Every such check asks, and only the user's own approval, in their words, authorizes the claim.

no_proposal.description: On an offer only: no message from the counterparty was sealed in this chain before the check, so the offer answers no proposal and there is none to go stale. Decided by the producer from its whole log. Never beside a source ref (the message an offer answers).

posting.description: On a post check (a sale's own log): the listing about to be posted. Its exact words as a salted commitment; the representation classes it states (the agent's label, shown on the card the user approves) and the platform it goes on, by the site's registrable domain, in the clear. A later post on the same platform replaces the earlier one there.

listing_classes.description: Rule input, on an offer or commit check of a sale's thread: the representation classes every live listing of the sale states when the check is made, the intersection over the latest post act per platform on the sale's log ([] when they state no class in common). Absent when the sale has no post act. Class names only, never a reference to the post.
